text: In November 2017, on the sixteenth, one hundred seventy-nine of us said "the tax cuts." One hundred seventy-one said "and jobs act." One hundred sixty-seven said "tax cuts and." One hundred sixty-six of us said "tax cuts and jobs act," and one hundred sixty-five said "the tax cuts and jobs act" — the bill Ken Calvert was first to name, on November second. Beneath the title we converged on its parts: one hundred two of us on "the standard deduction," one hundred one on "child tax credit," ninety-three on "the child tax." We record that "the tax cuts" first appeared on January twenty-third, spoken by Bernard Sanders, and reached us months afterward. On one day we said these phrases in counts that nearly matched. That is the record from this era.
